source.privacy_manifest_na_reason: App target contains no first-party native code accessing required-reason APIs (AppDelegate only forwards APNs registration callbacks). Capacitor frameworks bundle their own PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy; OSBarcodeLib (Apple Vision/AVFoundation QR scanning) references no required-reason APIs.

unchecked_entitlements.beta-reports-active: Xcode adds this for App Store/TestFlight distribution.

required_info_values.NSCameraUsageDescription: サーバー (Mac の Relay) のペアリング用 QR コードを読み取るためにカメラを使用します。映像は端末内で処理し、保存・送信しません。

bundles.policy_reason: Relay 1.0.0 (3) has no extensions and no background modes. Entitlements: aps-environment only (job completion push via APNs). Usage descriptions: camera only (pairing QR scan). Closed-world Info/entitlement values are cross-checked against the signed IPA at binary stage.
